data.description:
The Modified Bed Bath VR Simulator app immerses Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) trainees in a virtual environment where they can practice and master the skills required for providing a proper modified bed bath. 

With multi-language support (English, Spanish, French, and Arabic), this simulator ensures inclusivity and accessibility for a global audience.  

The experience is enhanced by an AI companion, acting as a virtual mentor, to answer questions to reinforce learning.
 
# Key Features: 
- Multi-Language Support: Tailored instructions and narrations in four major languages to cater to diverse learners. 
- AI Companion: An interactive assistant that responds to user queries, and provides clarifications to meet learning needs.(NOTE: Generative AI is still experimental)
 
# Learning Objectives:  
- Remembering the steps and protocols for giving a modified bed bath  
- Understanding the importance of hygiene and patient comfort 
- Applying the correct techniques for bathing different parts of the body 
- Analyzing the patient's condition to ensure no areas are missed 
- Creating a supportive and respectful environment for patients during the bathing process.  

This comprehensive approach ensures CNAs are well-prepared to perform modified bed baths effectively and compassionately in real-world clinical settings.
